recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist watercolor and ink illustration featuring a customized red 'slab' car with an open trunk and a vertical roadside sign, set against a vast, empty off-white background with utility poles receding into the distance.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical blue sign on the left balancing the horizontal red car on the right
Receding utility poles creating a sense of deep perspective in a flat space
High-contrast black shadows grounding the floating subjects
Hand-rendered lettering integrated into the physical objects
coreInvariants: Red car with 'swangas' (conical wire wheel rims)
Vertical motel-style sign with blue and yellow panels
Visible ink outlines and watercolor bleeds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The car is positioned in the lower right quadrant at a medium scale; the sign is in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red car acts as the primary visual anchor due to its saturated color and complex detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the vertical sign, follows the horizon line/utility poles to the right, and settles on the open trunk of the car.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space (approx. 70%) emphasizes isolation and a surreal, dreamlike atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background provides a neutral canvas for the subjects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Saturated Red (car) and Cyan Blue (sign) provide primary color contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow panels on the sign and orange highlights on the car's rear.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects against a desaturated, high-value background; deep black ink for shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Integrated into the 3D perspective of the objects
Varying stroke widths consistent with brush/pen application
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters on the sign are stacked vertically within individual white boxes
Letters in the trunk are angled to match the lid's perspective

composition.position: inside sign panels and trunk lid

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The vertical sign text pairs with the angled trunk text through shared hand-drawn execution.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, imperfect feel of the watercolor art.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a watercolor illustration on cream paper of a red customized car with spiked rims and an open trunk on the right, and a tall blue/yellow roadside sign on the left. Include thin utility poles receding into a flat horizon. Leave the sign panels and the inside of the trunk lid blank for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a hand-drawn ink style, paint uppercase block letters vertically on the sign panels and angled within the trunk lid to match the perspective.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent off-white paper texture?
Are the car's wheel spikes (swangas) prominent and conical?
Is the text integrated into the objects rather than floating?
Are the shadows deep black and sharp?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the car
Exact text content from the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the car looks like a 'slab' with specific rim modifications.
Verify the watercolor wash has varying transparency.
Check that the text follows the 3D plane of the objects.
Confirm the composition maintains significant negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Watercolor illustration + [Subject A: customized car] + [Subject B: roadside sign] + minimalist cream background + hand-inked perspective typography.
